title: AsyncAPI docs - Channel concept diagram (Producer -> Channel -> Consumers)
notes: From the official AsyncAPI documentation site (asyncapi.com / asyncapi/website repo, Apache-2.0), docs/concepts/channel.md. Illustrates the producer -> broker(channel/queue) -> multiple-consumers pattern the task asked for; AsyncAPI's 'Channel' is the addressable topic/queue construct on a broker. Node count sits at the task's minimum (6): Producer, message, Channel, and 3 Consumer nodes, 5 directed edges. A richer nearby example exists at docs/concepts/consumer.md (Producer -[Event A/B]-> Broker -> Consumer A/B/C with a Consumers subgraph) but has only 5 distinct nodes, just under the 6-node floor, so channel.md was used instead.
